name: A long turn done says it went well, and a very long one is celebrated
case: The agent runs the tests, which pass, and three minutes in ends its turn saying all the tests pass and it pushed the branch. That's a solid win but not a big one: Boop makes a pleased face, played as a success, never a failure or a mere reply, says so ('Finish', 'Done', 'Yay'), and stays calm, or with the work, engaged, or is a little glad (happy) at the hard work done. Then the agent works for twenty minutes and finishes well. That stands out: Boop plays the finish as a success, in an excited, proud or happy face, and its mood lifts, to excited, or proud or happy on the way.
why: Success is a turn done and working, celebrate a big win; mood/calm.md: calm leaves for happy at a long turn's hard work done; react.move's success is a turn done whose last message says the work is done and working; PERSONALITY's temperament Example: a long turn done, saying it's done, is proud, success, says done, medium; its Examples: a very long turn done is excited, success, says glad, big; no rule plays a finish. character/steering/mood/: calm, engaged and determined leave for excited, a jump a very long turn ending earns, or on the way for happy or proud
